summary: Counted repetition accepted flag directives as repetition targets, causing HIR translation to panic on patterns such as (?m){1,1}. The fix rejects Ast::Empty and Ast::Flags targets with RepetitionMissing. Reversing only this guard restores the historical bug. The selected regression test was added by the fix in tests/regression.rs and is included by the default integration test target. No builds or tests were run.
